chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Husayn ibn 'Uthman, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about the urine of horses and mules, and he said: Wash whatever of it has affected you.

key_terms.أَبْوَالِ: urine substances being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.أَصَابَكَ: what reaches or comes into contact with you
key_terms.اغْسِلْ: wash; the Imam’s direct legal instruction
key_terms.الْبِغَالِ: mules, another animal mentioned in the question
key_terms.الْخَيْلِ: horses, one of the animals mentioned in the question
key_terms.مِنْهُ: from it, referring to the urine mentioned

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on urine from horses and mules in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding contact with the urine of horses and mules. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that whatever of it reaches a person should be washed, indicating a practical ruling related to taharah (ritual purity).
